sources.quote: The Securities and Exchange Commission today charged audit firm BF Borgers CPA PC and its owner, Benjamin F. Borgers
sources.searcher_note: The underlying case: permanent bar, 1,500+ filings, 369 clients whose filings used Borgers audits; not about where clients went

notes: Pre-known: lead cites press. Pattern of stranded Borgers clients is well covered in 2024 (Bloomberg Tax: nearly 40% of ~180 had no new auditor by mid-June 2024; lead: 75 of 218 show no later audit). A search snippet attributed to the Bloomberg Law piece says thirteen former Borgers clients hired one of two Nigeria-based firms (Olayinka Oyebola & Co., Boladale Lawal & Co.), but that text sits behind the paywall and could not be confirmed on the page, so it is not quoted. No source found for the lead's 27 clients at four Nigerian firms or the 54/72/17 split by firm size. No coverage found dated after 2026-06-30. SEC.gov blocks scripted fetches; the SEC quote came via WebFetch. Bowmo's own release on hiring a Lagos auditor returned 404.
